definitions.explanation: The person who enters into a contract or subscription agreement. Used for insurance policyholders, phone subscribers, service contract holders, and parties to a legal agreement.

examples.japanese: {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: Only the subscriber themselves may use this service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: To change the policyholder of the insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯|けいたい}{電話|でんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please verify the mobile phone subscriber information.

examples.japanese: {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{受取人|うけとりにん}→受取人：19162_uketorinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保険金|ほけんきん}→保険金：15653_hokenkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われる→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: In the event of the policyholder's death, the insurance benefit is paid to the beneficiary.

notes:
A formal term used in legal, insurance, telecommunications, and service contexts. Anyone dealing with Japanese bureaucracy, insurance, or phone contracts will encounter this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧: the subscriber/policyholder themselves
- {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: subscriber/contract holder information
- {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change of contract holder
- {保険|ほけん}{契約者|けいやくしゃ}: insurance policyholder
- {契約者|けいやくしゃ}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: subscriber number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加入者|かにゅうしゃ}→加入者：22913_kanyuusha⟧: member, subscriber — used for membership-based services and organizations
- ⟦{被保険者|ひほけんしゃ}→被保険者：23617_hihokensha⟧: insured person — the person covered by insurance (may differ from the policyholder)
- ⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧: user — the person actually using the service
- ⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧: party (to an agreement) — broader legal term for involved parties

FORMS:
⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (contract) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person) — literally "contract person."
